name: 🐷 Pork Carnitas Tacos
tagline: Slow cooker does the work all day; a quick broil at the end makes the edges crispy.

steps.text: Morning: cut the pork into 4 big chunks. Rub with salt, cumin, oregano and chili powder.
Put the onion and garlic in the slow cooker, pork on top. Pour in the orange juice and the juice of 2 limes; add bay leaves.
Cook on LOW 8 hours (or HIGH 5) until it falls apart.
Dinner: shred the pork with two forks right in the pot; toss with the juices.
Spread on a sheet pan, spoon over ½ cup of the juices, and broil 5–7 minutes until the edges crisp. Watch it.
Warm the tortillas. Set out cilantro, chopped onion, lime wedges, salsa verde and avocado.
Build tacos. Save leftovers in some of the juice so they stay moist.

kid_jobs.job: Squeeze the limes and pour in the juice

chef_tip: The broil at the end is everything: crispy edges plus juicy middle is what makes it carnitas and not just pulled pork.
make_ahead: Cook the pork up to 3 days ahead; broil right before dinner.
leftovers: Freezes great in its juices. Carnitas bowls, quesadillas or nachos later in the week.
swaps: Instant Pot: 60 minutes on high, natural release
Corn tortillas, charred over the flame
serve_with: Black beans, Minute rice with lime, or street corn
heads_up: Start the slow cooker in the morning (8 hours on low).

game_plan.what: Season the pork; kids load onion, garlic and juices in the cooker.
Slow cooker on LOW (or HIGH 5 hr) and leave it alone.
Shred the pork right in the pot with the juices.
Spread on a sheet pan and broil until crisp. Watch it.
Kids warm tortillas and set out the taco bar.
Build tacos; save leftovers in some juice.
